chunks: Everything in it that is from al-Ḥusayn ibn Ḥammād, I have narrated from my father and from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah and al-Ḥimyarī together, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Bazantī, from ʿAbd al-Karīm ibn ʿAmr, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Ḥammād al-Kūfī.

key_terms.الْكُوفِيِّ: al-Kufi; identifying the narrator's affiliation with Kufa.
key_terms.جَمِيعًا: together; indicating combined transmission from more than one transmitter.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a technical term indicating narration in hadith transmission.
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: from my father; part of the compiler's immediate transmission link.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to al-Ḥusayn ibn Ḥammād in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage provides the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from al-Ḥusayn ibn Ḥammād in the book. It identifies the chain through the compiler's teachers back to al-Ḥusayn ibn Ḥammād al-Kūfī, serving as a source clarification in hadith transmission.
